opening.argument: The video presents a step-by-step tutorial for buying BNB through Phantom Wallet, beginning with the instruction, "Tap the Buy button on the home screen." It explains network selection and directs viewers to an integrated third-party provider, then to enter a chosen spending amount, provide debit or credit card details, and complete identity verification if requested. These are ordinary operational instructions for a cryptocurrency purchase, not a promise of returns or another benefit. The frames and spoken instructions describe BNB being sent to the wallet after confirmation and an updated balance appearing, but they do not establish that the provider is safe, that any transaction occurred, or that these claims were independently verified.

citations.quote: This is a tutorial on how to buy BNB on phantom wallet in 2026.
Phantom will redirect you to an integrated third-party provider such as Moonpay or another supported onRamp.
Follow the prompts to enter your payment details using a debit card or credit card.
